newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:

Spokesman Jochen Kubosch said the Court of Justice had taken decisions against Luxembourg, Italy and Germany for non-transposition of directives in the field of telecommunications, agriculture and dangerous substances. He also said the Court had reached decisions on files concerning taxation in the French overseas departments, potato flour and married woman caring for a sick husband. He said decision texts would be available in his office.

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said Commissioner Emma Bonino and the Irish presidency would hold a joint news conference on Great Lakes crisis at 1700/1600 GMT after special development ministers Council.
In answer to a question, van der Pas said the orientation debate on tobacco had not taken place during Wednesday's Commission weekly meeting and had been postponed to next week.
He also said there had been no substantial debate on television without frontiers and that the Commission would give its decision after debate in the European Parliament.

- IP/96/979: Infringements by France: incorrect application of VAT arrangements.
- IP/96/980: Infringements by Italy - restriction of the right to deduct VAT.
- IP/96/994: Commission to support the reform process in China.
- IP/96/995: Launch of high level expert group on worker involvement.
- IP/96/996: Commissioner van den Broek takes part in troika visit to Moscow: 7-9 November 1996.
- IP/96/997: European Commission outlines priorities for key meeting with European and American businessmen in Chicago.
- IP/96/998: EU-Cambodia: signature of the cooperation agreement.
- IP/96/1000: The European Union will conclude an agreement on customs cooperation and mutual assistance in customs matters with the United States.
- IP/96/1001: Ecu 29 million for urban renewal in the UK.

- Speech/96/276: Speech by Commissioner Franz Fischler on Europe and its rural areas in 2000.
- Speech/96/277: Speech by Commissioner Padraig Flynn on "an information society for everybody".
- Speech/96/278: Speech by Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy at "Jacques Rueff" colloquium.
- Memo/96/105: Euro-Mediterranean partnership: implementation of the multilateral aspects of the Barcelona declaration.
- The development of rural areas.
